# Standard Library Tour

A map of **when to reach for which module** before you add a dependency. Language → Stdlib essentials is the working set; this part is the index.

## Planned chapters

| Cluster | Modules |
|---------|---------|
| Text and I/O | `pathlib`, `io`, `json`, `csv`, `tomllib` |
| Time | `datetime`, `zoneinfo`, `time` |
| Process | `os`, `subprocess`, `signal`, `argparse` |
| Concurrency | `threading`, `multiprocessing`, `asyncio`, `queue` |
| Data | `collections`, `heapq`, `array`, `dataclasses` |
| Quality | `unittest`, `doctest`, `logging`, `warnings` |
| Net | `socket`, `ssl`, `http`, `urllib`, `email` |
| Internals | `sys`, `gc`, `dis`, `inspect`, `importlib` |

Official tours: [part 1](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/stdlib.html), [part 2](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/stdlib2.html), then the [library index](https://docs.python.org/3/library/index.html).
